name: RareBotsHub File Replace Bot
description: Telegram bot to replace channel/group post media & captions instantly or in bulk, open to all users with live multi force-subscribe.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API HASH from https://my.telegram.org

ADMINS.description: Space separated extra admin user IDs (optional)

FORCE_SUB_CHANNELS.description: Comma separated channel usernames/-100 ids for multi force-subscribe (optional)

FSUB_CHANNEL_CACHE_TTL.description: Seconds a resolved channel's admin-status/invite-link is cached (optional)

START_PICS.description: Comma separated image URLs to randomly show on /start (optional)

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Channel ID (e.g. -1001234567890) to log new users (optional)
